title: 27 Shantalla Drive, Dublin 9, Beaumont, Dublin 9, D09PD81
seoTitle: 27 Shantalla Drive, Dublin 9, Beaumont, Dublin 9, D09PD81
description:
Smith & Butler Estates proudly present 27 Shantalla Drive to the sales market. This charming three-bedroom semi-detached home with a side extension and attic room is beautifully maintained and located in a peaceful cul-de-sac. The property boasts spacious and versatile living spaces, complemented by its highly convenient location.

The property benefits from a side extension, where the kitchen is located, allowing the original layout to provide a generous dining area and two large living rooms, ideal for both everyday family life and entertaining. The extended kitchen opens onto a west-facing garden, perfect for enjoying afternoon and evening sunlight. A further advantage is the rear pedestrian access onto Shantalla Road, placing cafés and shops just a two-minute stroll away. The first floor consists of three extremely well-proportioned bedrooms, two of which are double and include built-in wardrobes. The first floor also includes a modern and spacious family bathroom, offering convenience for family living. The interior accommodation is complete by a spacious converted attic which is currently being used as a twin bedroom and includes an en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower.

Nestled in a mature and highly sought-after residential enclave, 27 Shantalla Drive offers the perfect balance of quiet suburban living and exceptional urban convenience. This premier location is a commuter’s dream, boasting immediate access to both the M1 and M50 motorways, a quick 10-minute drive to Dublin Airport, and plenty of bus routes to Dublin City Centre. The property is within easy walking distance of Dublin City University (DCU) and a superb selection of respected local primary and secondary schools. Exceptional everyday amenities are right on your doorstep, from the extensive retail, dining, and cinema options at the nearby Omni Park Shopping Centre to the stunning 85-acre Santry Demesne park, which offers beautiful woodland walks and playgrounds just moments away. Offered chain free, this home presents an excellent opportunity to purchase a spacious property in a highly sought-after, peaceful location that remains close to all essential amenities.

Features:

Open plan layout

Solid fuel Stanley stove

Rear access

Fully fitted kitchen

Off street parking

Excellent location

Alarm

Double and Triple glazed windows

Fitted blinds

Fitted wardrobes and hall storage

All external walls internally dry-lined

Roof fully insulated

Local amenities nearby

Excellent transport links M1 and M50 in close proximity

Accommodation:

Foyer – 1.28m x 1.74m – A bright, welcoming entrance area with bespoke joinery hardwood entrance door and glazing, tiled flooring leading on to the hallway. There is ample integrated storage provided via bespoke cabinetry.

Hallway - 5.05m x 1.75m - A bright and welcoming entrance hallway with carpeted staircase to the first floor. Storage recess with display cabinet. Entrance to guest bathroom and tiled flooring continuing through to the kitchen and dining areas.

Living Room – 7.73m x 3.92m – A spacious and versatile living room off the foyer, finished with solid flooring, a solid fuel Stanley stove, pendant lighting and wall-mounted TV point. Excellent for relaxing and entertaining.

Dining Area – 2.62 m x 2.54 m – A bright space positioned within the open-plan kitchen extension, with sleek tiled flooring and uninterrupted flow through to the kitchen and living room beyond. With sliding doors leading onto the rear garden, fitted blinds, feature dropped pendant lighting and tiled floor covering.

Kitchen – 3.20m x 2.41m – A bright, open-plan kitchen with frameless, triple-glazed, flat rooflight, flooding the space with natural light, cabinetry providing excellent storage space and integrated appliances including an electric hob, oven, and quartz countertop and upstand. Anthracite black feature panelled wall heater.

Guest Bathroom 2.01m x 0.72m – With heated towel rack, W.H.B, W.C

Hallway (Upstairs) 3.04m x 1.73m – The upper landing area provides access to the primary bedroom, two further bedrooms, family bathroom and attic conversion. With carpeted flooring and pendant lighting.

Primary Bedroom – 3.83 m x 3.92 m – A bright and spacious double bedroom featuring a wall of fitted wardrobes, solid-wood flooring, pendant lighting and a window dressed with curtains overlooking the rear of the property.

Bedroom – 3.78 m x 3.92 m – A bright and spacious double bedroom to the front of the property, with solid-wood flooring, pendant lighting, fitted blinds and excellent wardrobe space.

Bedroom – 2.42 m x 2.69 m – A versatile and comfortable bedroom with laminate-wood flooring, pendant lighting and a window dressed with blinds providing natural light. 

Bath 2.75m x 1.74m – A stylish family bathroom finished in floor to ceiling tiling, with a bathtub featuring a shower head and curtain, wall mounted mirror, and WC, plus a frosted window for privacy.

Bedroom (Attic) – 4.31m x 3.72m – A spacious converted attic room with sloped ceilings and dual Velux skylights, fitted eaves storage, soft carpeted flooring and its own private en-suite shower room.

En-suite (Attic) 1.67m x 2.00m– A discreet en-suite shower room tucked into the attic conversion, with white brick-effect tiling, a glass shower enclosure, and compact wall-mounted basin.

Total – 115 Sq.M - 1238 Sq.FT.

Externally - To the front, the property benefits from a spacious paved driveway providing off-street parking and mature planting. 

To the front side there is out of sight storage space for bins, bikes and the electric car charger.

The rear of the property benefits from a generously sized garden with a cobbled lock surface and a wooden fence surround for added privacy. Excellent for relaxing, entertaining and outdoor dining.
